system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Tier (`compact`, `mid`, `full`) is a per-provider setting controlling how many tools a model sees
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt/tool set varies by tier and mode; skills load only when relevant.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The agent uses this as its first action on almost every turn — it's faster and cheaper than a screenshot

context_compaction.evidence_quote: **Smart context** — token-aware auto-compaction, tool-result limits, and emergency overflow recovery

observation_format.evidence_quote: via the accessibility tree rather than brittle selectors
observation_format.note: Screenshots via /screenshot and auto-screenshot loop; vision descriptions.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote:
All providers normalize to
`{ content, toolCalls, usage }`

tool_count.evidence_quote: The server exposes task delegation rather than the ~50 low-level browser primitives
tool_count.note: Approximate; actual count per tier (compact/mid/full) not enumerated in evidence.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Adds page source, styles, console, network, and reversible page edits.
edit_primitive.note: Browser agent; no file-editing primitive — edits are page edits, not files.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: **Tool schema** — define the name, description, and parameters in `tools.js`
tool_schema_source.note: Skill tools declare JSON Schema parameters in a manifest; MCP bridge also present.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: mcp-server/ MCP server — delegate browser tasks from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor
protocol_standardization.note: Also WebMCP mentioned in agent-tools docs.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: **Multi-step agent** — autonomous tool-use loop, configurable up to 195 steps
loop_primitives.note: Plan before Act is an opt-in plan mode (/plan).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Act and Dev can generate a structured plan, show it for approval, and pin the approved plan to the scratchpad before any tool runs

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote:
puts an AI agent in a side panel next to
your tabs

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote:
WebBrain's permission gate
lives in the agent loop
delegation_mechanism.note: External coding agents can delegate tasks in via MCP, but WebBrain itself spawns no sub-agents.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: with per-site permission prompts before consequential actions

short_term_state.evidence_quote: pin the approved plan to the scratchpad before any tool runs

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: **Skills** — trusted instructions and tools that load only when relevant
long_term_memory.note: Also optional local user memory (/memory --add) and saved workflows.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: **Per-tab conversations** — each tab keeps its own history
state_persistence.note: Continue button resumes after step limit; no explicit full-resume path in evidence.

self_verification.evidence_quote:
click, type, scroll, navigate, upload, download, and verify
forms
self_verification.note: Harness-enforced verification limited to form verification/loop detection; no test execution or judge model documented.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: with a Continue button when it hits the limit
retry_policy.note: No task-level retry policy documented; continuation is user-initiated.

rollback.evidence_quote: Adds page source, styles, console, network, and reversible page edits.
rollback.note: Reversible page edits in Dev mode; no repo/VCS rollback.

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
autonomous tool-use loop, configurable up to 195 steps
(default 130), with a Continue button when it hits the limit
termination_condition.note: Loop detection mirrored to Firefox; user stop button also available.

cost_controls.evidence_quote:
token-aware auto-compaction, tool-result limits, and
emergency overflow recovery

timeouts.evidence_quote: no `resolveSelector` retry budget, no SPA-navigation-aware retry
timeouts.note: Per-tool retry/stability budgets on Chrome; no run-level wall clock documented.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote:
WebBrain is a web browser extension that puts an AI agent in a side panel next to
your tabs.
execution_isolation.note: Actions run in the user's own browser via content scripts/service worker; no sandbox boundary.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Both are injected into `<all_urls>` pages at `document_idle`.
filesystem_access.note: No host filesystem access beyond browser downloads/uploads.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Reads the page, answers questions, fetches URLs.
network_policy.note: Skill tools declare inputUrlAllowlist, but core browsing is unrestricted.

permission_model.evidence_quote: with per-site permission prompts before consequential actions

tracing.note: Traces recorded by default (/export --traces); OTLP conversion script ships.

replayability.evidence_quote:
**Saved workflows** — turn a successful run into a reusable, value-free
workflow you can re-run, export, and share

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: test/ Node test suite, LLM scenario benchmarks, security corpora
eval_hooks.note: ci/catalog/scenarios.json and ci/lib/grader.mjs ship in repo.

guardrails.note: Untrusted resultPolicy on skill tool results; permission gate blocks actions.
